morphology.pattern_note: 整词词根；c 读 /t͡ʃ/。食物义加 meN- 时采用 meng-：meN- + acar → mengacar，词首 a 保留。部分口音不明显发出词尾 r。

word_family.gloss: 吉打方言：厨房污物倾倒处，与食物义区分

senses.zh_definition: 阿杂；以蔬菜或水果等配料加醋调制的酸味腌菜，常配米饭食用。
senses.en_definition: A pickle made with vegetables, fruit, or other ingredients seasoned with vinegar, commonly served with rice.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis makanan daripada buah-buahan atau sayur-sayuran dengan bahan lain yang diasamkan dengan cuka dan dimakan bersama nasi.
senses.nuances: 可有甜、辣或香料味；不一定经过乳酸发酵，也不能把所有 jeruk 都叫作 acar。除蔬果外，还有 acar telur 等名称。马来文释义据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=acar)展开缩写。

senses.zh_definition: 厨房污物或废水的倾倒处；吉打方言词。
senses.en_definition: In Kedah dialect, a place for disposing of kitchen waste or wastewater.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam dialek Kedah, tempat membuang kotoran dapur; limbah.
senses.nuances: DBP 另列为 acar II，与食物义属于不同词条，也写作 acaran。不是一般餐饮场景的默认解释。以下为释义性搭配，不宣称高频。[DBP：acar II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=acar)。

collocations.ms: membuang kotoran dapur ke dalam acar
collocations.zh: 把厨房污物倒入倾倒处
collocations.en: dispose of kitchen waste in the waste-disposal area

collocations.zh: 屋后的厨房污物倾倒处
collocations.en: the kitchen-waste disposal area behind the house

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Menu jamuan tersebut merangkumi nasi minyak, ayam masak merah dan acar timun.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该宴会的菜单包括香油饭、红酱鸡和黄瓜醋腌菜。
dual_scenarios.en: The banquet menu includes fragrant ghee rice, chicken in a spiced red sauce, and cucumber pickle.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak acar sikit je, jangan letak banyak sangat.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu sedikit acar sahaja. Jangan letakkan terlalu banyak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我要一点点阿杂就好，别放太多。
dual_scenarios.en: Just a little pickle for me, please. Don't put too much.
spoken_features: letak 在口语祈使句中对应标准语 letakkan。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak acar sikit je, jangan letak banyak sangat.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu sedikit acar sahaja. Jangan letakkan terlalu banyak.
messages.zh: 我要一点点阿杂就好，别放太多。
messages.en: Just a little pickle for me, please. Don't put too much.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey. Kalau nak tambah, acar ada lagi kat dapur.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah. Jika kamu mahu menambahnya, masih ada acar di dapur.
messages.zh: 行。想再加的话，厨房里还有阿杂。
messages.en: Okay. There's more pickle in the kitchen if you want seconds.

etymology.historical_story: The food name acar belongs to a wider family of pickle names around the Indian Ocean, commonly traced to Persian āchār. Regional cuisines adapted the preparation to local ingredients and tastes. This culinary history concerns the pickle sense; it does not establish a shared origin for the separate Kedah word for a kitchen-waste disposal place. [VOC glossary](https://www.cortsfoundation.org/images/PDF/VOC_Glossary_Indonesia_V20180206_3.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: a.car 的 c 发“ch”音，近似“阿查”；联想餐盘旁那份酸酸脆脆的阿杂。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 做客时可以说 Sedikit acar, terima kasih 来礼貌地要一点配菜。若不喜欢酸味，可说 Saya ambil sedikit sahaja，语气较温和。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在餐桌、宴席和点餐场景中，默认指食物。遇到吉打方言或旧式文本时，再按上下文辨认污物倾倒处的同形词义。
